notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 91 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/50NPk7xF3Tt6X3DVucE9jU?si=44d2b7d44a5a4aec) with @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for add clearing Minor spec enemies in general content. Like other High-Impact Rocket Launchers with their high blast radius, Sleepless really only has one role, and that's add clearing - maybe for Gunsmith bounties. If you're going that way, you could maximise the Blast Radius with Volatile Launch as the barrel perk, and then boost Velocity with High-Velocity Rounds or reload Speed with Alloy Casing in the mag. You might as well have as many rockets to shoots as you can, so Field Prep boosts your reserves by one and reload speed further, as the first trait perk to support Chain Reaction in the second to really make sure that everything in the blast radius is dead. The Advanced Reflexes origin trait is quite useful in PvE - when activated by an enemy hit, it adds +30 Handling for additional ready and ADS speed, together with a handy +20 Mobility, for 7.5s. Recommended MW: Velocity or Reload Speed, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod. Tags: PvE, PvE-MinorSpec, PvE-EndGame, PvE-God, M+KB, Controller

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Sleepless is an interesting rocket. It was great when rockets could be used everywhere and when we didn’t have to reload via Lunafaction Boots or Rally Barricades. Currently you’ll find very limited uses out of most rockets. There are a few options that have risen to the top, but it means most rockets are going to fall into general utility tools. Sleepless has Chain Reaction for better add clear, and Auto-Loading Holster for quality of life. You might be able to squeeze out some solid DPS with Field Prep but without a good damage perk you’ll fall behind almost immediately." Recommended MW: Velocity.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Crucible rockets need one thing, a great blast radius. Sleepless has that in droves. With a blast radius masterwork you’ll sit at 100 even, that way you can invest your other perks into velocity and handling, bringing up some of its lower stats. With Quick Launch and High-Velocity Rounds you’re looking at a nice 60 velocity. It won’t beat Impulse Amplifier for the quickest rocket but it will move. Chain Reaction then becomes great for dealing with multiple guardians in every gamemode." Recommended MW: Velocity.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 23. PvE first choice roll for general content. Middle of the road for raw damage, so not optimal for endgame activities. If you're using for single-weapon sustained damage against Bosses, you'll want to get as many rockets out as possible within a damage phase. Quick Launch or Smart Drift Control help both velocity and handling, Alloy Casing speeds up reloads, as does Field Prep (which gives you an extra rocket in reserves too), and Demolitionist gives you a second quick initial shot when you throw a grenade to reload. Recommended MW: Reload Speed, with a damage boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 23. PvE first choice roll for general content. Middle of the road for raw damage, so not optimal for endgame activities. If you're using for sustained damage against Bosses with a special weapon, you'll want be able to swap quickly to continue damage while Auto-Loading Holster kicks in. Quick Launch or Smart Drift Control help both velocity and handling, Impact Casing boosts damage, Auto-Loading Holster does it's job while you're continuing damage, and then either Demolitionist gives you a second quick initial shot when you throw a grenade to reload or Vorpal Weapon gives a flat 10% damage boost. Recommended MW: Velocity or Handling, with a damage boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 23. PvE first choice roll for general content. Middle of the road for raw damage, so not optimal for endgame activities. If you're using for burst damage against a single target, using Tracking Module, you'll want the rocket to travel as slowly as possible, to be able to correct for any jinking or teleporting. Impact Casing boosts damage and then either Demolitionist gives you a second quick initial shot when you throw a grenade to reload or Vorpal Weapon gives a flat 10% damage boost. Recommended MW: Reload Speed, with a damage boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 23. PvE first choice roll for endgame content. Middle of the road for raw damage, but the largest blast radius of any subtype. Maximise the blast radius with barrel and mag, and then Field Prep helps with reloads and inventory or Auto-Loading Holster lets you put the launcher away to focus on other enemies. Chain Reaction can help clear beefier adds in a crowd with minors. Recommended MW: Velocity, with a damage boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.

Field Prep/Vorpal is fairly good for sustained DPS, though you'll want to hunt for a Clown Cartridge weapon elsewhere if that's your goal." tags:pve
